articles.title: Mobile Phone Lost – What To Do?
articles.summary: Complete step-by-step guide to block SIM, protect personal data and track a lost or stolen mobile phone.

content.intro: Losing a mobile phone can be stressful because it contains personal data, banking apps, emails and private photos. Immediate action can help prevent misuse and financial loss.
steps: Immediately block your SIM card by calling your mobile network operator customer care
Use Google Find My Device (Android) or Find My iPhone (Apple) to locate, lock or erase your phone
Change passwords of important accounts such as Google, WhatsApp, Facebook and banking apps
Inform your bank if mobile banking or UPI apps were installed
File a police complaint if required for insurance or phone recovery
tips: Always enable screen lock and biometric security
Keep Find My Device turned ON
Avoid saving sensitive passwords in notes or gallery

faq.q: Can I track my phone if it is switched off?
faq.a: You can only see the last known location when the phone was online using Google Find My Device or iCloud.
FIR is not always mandatory, but it is required for insurance claims or phone blocking in some cases.

articles.title: WhatsApp Account Hacked – Recovery Guide
articles.summary: How to recover a hacked WhatsApp account and secure it from future attacks.

content.intro: WhatsApp account hacking usually happens through OTP scams or SIM swap fraud. Acting quickly can help you regain control.
steps: Reinstall WhatsApp and verify your number again
Request OTP and do not share it with anyone
Enable two-step verification from WhatsApp settings
Email WhatsApp support if account access is blocked
tips: Never share OTP with anyone claiming to be from WhatsApp
Enable email recovery option in WhatsApp

faq.q: Can hackers read my old chats?
faq.a: No, chats are end-to-end encrypted unless backup access is compromised.

articles.title: DigiLocker Login Problem – Solution
articles.summary: Solutions for DigiLocker login issues, OTP problems and missing documents.

content.intro: DigiLocker is widely used for storing Aadhaar, driving license and academic documents. Login issues are common due to OTP or Aadhaar mismatch.
steps: Ensure your mobile number is linked with Aadhaar
Retry login using Aadhaar or mobile option
Clear browser cache or update DigiLocker app
Contact DigiLocker support if documents are missing
tips: Always keep Aadhaar mobile number updated

faq.a: Yes, DigiLocker documents are legally valid as per Government of India guidelines.

articles.title: UPI Transaction Failed – Refund Process
articles.summary: Step-by-step process to raise complaint and get refund for failed UPI transactions.

content.intro: UPI failures may happen due to server issues or connectivity problems. Refunds are usually processed automatically.
steps: Wait for 24–48 hours for automatic reversal
Check transaction status in your UPI app
Raise complaint via bank or UPI app
Contact bank customer support if refund not received

faq.q: How long does UPI refund take?
faq.a: Most refunds are processed within 2–3 working days.
